INSERT INTO wf_market_daily_trade_average (item_id, platform, trade_day, variant_key, variant_json, `rank`, min_price, max_price, average_price, volume, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{r.itemId}, 'pc', #{r.tradeDay}, #{r.variantKey}, #{r.variantJson}, #{r.rank}, #{r.minPrice}, #{r.maxPrice}, #{r.averagePrice}, #{r.volume}, #{r.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE variant_json=VALUES(variant_json), `rank`=VALUES(`rank`), min_price=VALUES(min_price), max_price=VALUES(max_price), average_price=VALUES(average_price), volume=VALUES(volume), fetched_at=VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average WHERE platform = 'pc' AND trade_day NOT IN (#{targetDay}, #{previousDay}) ORDER BY trade_day LIMIT 5000
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average WHERE platform='pc' AND trade_day=#{day} AND fetched_at=#{fetchedAt}

SELECT s.*, i.url_name, i.zh_name, i.en_name, i.max_rank FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average s JOIN wf_market_item i ON i.id=s.item_id WHERE s.platform='pc' AND s.trade_day=#{day} AND s.average_price > 0 AND s.volume > 0
AND s.min_price > 0 AND s.max_price > 0
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average p WHERE p.item_id=s.item_id AND p.platform=s.platform AND p.trade_day=s.trade_day AND p.average_price > 0 AND p.volume > 0
AND p.min_price > 0 AND p.max_price > 0
AND (JSON_CONTAINS(COALESCE(i.tags, '[]'), JSON_QUOTE('mod'))=0 OR COALESCE(LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.variant_json, '$.subtype'))), '') <> 'atragraph') AND (p.`rank` > s.`rank` OR (p.`rank`=s.`rank` AND p.variant_key < s.variant_key)) )
AND s.`rank`=0 AND i.max_rank IS NOT NULL AND s.`rank`=i.max_rank
AND s.`rank`=#{criteria.exactRank}
ORDER BY
s.min_price s.max_price s.volume s.average_price
DESC ASC
, s.item_id, s.variant_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
